acceptance: Collapsed frame speech preserves exact material-light total and exact active/blocked/fault/recovered counts.
FAULT/BLOCKED identities are named before non-attention identities within the existing twelve-name speech ceiling while actual scene/focus order remains unchanged.
Compact per-node content description bounds consequence speech by Unicode code points without splitting a surrogate pair.
Typed detail retains complete reason, consequence, evidence, and source after compact speech is bounded.

The new attention-map specimen is touch/keyboard reachable DOM/vector source, uses non-color state tokens, native buttons, textContent/DOM construction, and no decorative motion loop.
The specimen does not light a doctrine merely because it was named in the automation prompt; its twenty shown lights each carry a material constraint/action/review/boundary for this source slice.
No P0/phone mutation or duplicate controller is introduced.
Regression source exists, but TESTED is not promoted without executed checks.
